entities.summary: The Sidi Saiyyed Mosque, popularly known locally as Sidi Saiyyid ni Jali, is a Sunni mosque, located in Ahmedabad, in the state of Gujarat, India. The mosque was built by Sidi Sayyad, a Habshi nobleman, in 980 AH (1572/1573 CE). The structure is a Monument of National Importance. Sidi Saiyyed Mosque is a mosque in Asia, established in 1573. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
